caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and a single nori sheet resting atop. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it sits on a red surface under bright, even lighting.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, solid red surface with subtle light reflections and faint texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows translucent, tender texture with visible fat marbling and slightly curled edges.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly curled, uneven surface.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with blue and green geometric patterns and Chinese characters along its rim.
A dark, glossy spoon with a curved bowl and textured surface, reflecting light subtly.
